title: Slack pricing - $7.25-$15 list per user/month, real paid range up to $28.10
clean_text: Slack's published 2026 tiers are Free, Pro at $7.25/user/month (annual billing), Business+ at roughly $12.50-$15/user/month (annual billing), and Enterprise Grid at custom pricing typically starting around $15+/user/month. Vendr's analysis of 535 verified real-world Slack purchases found actual per-user pricing ranging from $7.25 to $28.10 per month depending on plan, with enterprise buyers paying a median of $26.18 per user/month; most buyers negotiate 10-20% below list, with larger organizations achieving the lowest per-user rates.
